author: Larion Roman
developer_reply: Hello, the app allows you to complete previous days because it doesn't expect you to necessarily track your habits every day, so it makes it more convenient to add data on "yesterday" or "the day before yesterday". I understand you might not find this useful but it's simply a design decision many people appreciate.
